dedupe_keys.name: ashrae climatic design conditions and weather data viewer handbook fundamentals chapter 14

description: ASHRAE publishes climatic design information for stations worldwide in Chapter 14 of its Handbook—Fundamentals and sells it through its Weather Data Center. The Weather Data Viewer covers the 12,424 stations in the 2025 Handbook (June 2025), with design condition summaries, frequency plots, wind roses, degree-days to any base, design-day profiles and return-period temperatures; StationFinder maps stations from the 2001 to 2025 editions. The centre also sells IWEC2 typical weather files for 3,012 locations outside the U.S. and Canada, the 2021 Chapter 14 tables for 9,237 locations, Standard 169 climate zones, and a data licence for software developers. Coverage: worldwide weather stations. Access: paid products; the viewer needs a login. Licence: ASHRAE copyright, personal use only, no redistribution without written permission. Caveats: ASHRAE also forbids entering its publications into AI tools, so only product pages were used here. Simulation uses: design dry-bulb, wet-bulb and dew-point conditions and degree-days for sizing HVAC plant and for building energy simulation. Related records: Climate.OneBuilding.Org, whose files embed ASHRAE design conditions.
